sections.title: Production MCP Server with HTTP Transport — Project Structure
sections.body:
```
production_mcp/
│
├── server/
│   ├── main.py                ← FastAPI + FastMCP HTTP server
│   ├── config.py              ← Settings & environment config
│   ├── auth.py                ← API key + JWT authentication
│   ├── middleware.py          ← Rate limiting, logging, CORS
│   ├── tools/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   ├── search_tools.py    ← Web search, deep search
│   │   ├── compute_tools.py   ← Calculator, code execution
│   │   ├── data_tools.py      ← DB queries, file ops
│   │   └── ai_tools.py        ← Embeddings, summarization
│   ├── resources/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   └── knowledge_base.py  ← Knowledge resources
│   └── prompts/
│       └── templates.py       ← Prompt templates
│
├── client/
│   ├── mcp_http_client.py     ← Generic HTTP MCP client
│   ├── azure_client.py        ← Azure OpenAI + MCP
│   └── langgraph_client.py    ← LangGraph + MCP
│
├── docker/
│   ├── Dockerfile
│   └── docker-compose.yml
│
├── tests/
│   └── test_server.py
│
└── requirements.txt
```
